page.overview:
What is Nanimonai Island?

Nanimonai Island is an uninhabited island just before the Arabasta Kingdom. In reality, it is not a full island but rather the feces produced after a giant goldfish ate a whole island.

Sometime over a hundred years ago, the Giant Warrior Pirates landed on this island, mistaking it for dry land.

Miss All-Sunday gave Vivi an Eternal Pose to this island to help the Straw Hat Pirates reach Arabasta. However, while Vivi was contemplating whether or not she should accept, Luffy suddenly grabbed the pose and destroyed it, refusing to let an enemy choose their route.

In the anime and live-action series, Nanimonai Island's name was written on the Eternal Pose that Miss All-Sunday gave to the Straw Hats, while it was absent in the manga.
